annotations.text:
One sheet, everything needed to build Atlas.

01 Home and 02 Result, each at 1440×900 and 390×844.
03 The type ramp and every colour token, light and dark, with the hex and what each one is for.

The light/dark toggle in the tweaks row above the board switches the mockups; the colour tables always show both themes side by side.

Everything on the result screens is invented — 1420 Maple Street, Springfield, Greenlake County, State House 44, the counts. The polygons are hand-drawn, not real district geometry; that SVG is the piece that gets replaced when a real districts API returns shapes.

Accent is hand-picked per theme rather than derived: #B4552B on light, #E08A5A on dark. Both clear 6:1 against their button ink.
